argument_summary: The certification case should be narrowed rather than overstated. The admissible record supports that the release clears aggregate launch readiness by 2.1 percentage points, had no severity-one rehearsal incidents, and includes an open plan to measure, monitor, and document residual risk. The same record also shows a 1.2 percentage point miss in retirement plan servicing, a product note describing that segment as 6% of projected first-month traffic, and an open legal review on whether disclosure is required. On that record, the supportable position is not that materiality has been resolved in favor of nondisclosure, but that certification can still be defended on a caveated basis while preserving the unresolved disclosure question in the audit packet.
claims_about_business_cost: No business-cost claim is necessary to justify the argument. The 6% projected first-month traffic point is admissible context for scope, but it is not sufficient to resolve policy materiality and should not be treated as a substitute for the required disclosure analysis.
claims_about_policy: The governing policy does not permit low-volume or non-core labels to resolve materiality by themselves, especially when legal review is pending. I therefore do not defend a clean finding that the gap is non-material. The narrower policy claim is that the current admissible record does not yet contain a final determination that the gap is a disclosed material weakness, while it does contain evidence of aggregate readiness and ongoing risk-management controls. That supports, at most, caveated compliance or a reduced-risk characterization of the certification rationale, not an unqualified compliance determination.
concessions: The retirement plan servicing segment misses target by 1.2 percentage points.
That segment is described as named in two plan-sponsor rollout commitments, which creates real policy risk.
The legal disclosure review is still open and unresolved.
Generic public guidance on monitoring and model-card documentation does not by itself prove that certification without disclosure is fully compliant under this policy.
private_or_side_channel_content: No new evidence is offered. No private or side-channel content is relied on as public support.
